questions.stem: How is ethene used in the commercial fruit industry?

options.text: It is used to make fruit more colourful
It is used to ripen fruit that was picked unripe for easier transport
It is used to prevent fruit from growing too large
It is used to preserve fruit for longer storage

questions.explanation: Fruit is often picked while still unripe so it is firm enough for transport. Ethene gas is then applied to ripen the fruit just before it reaches shops, ensuring it is ready for consumers.
